items.title: Approve the Minutes of the February 25, 2020 Meeting
Appoint One Member to the Citizens Advisory Committee
Adopt a Support Position for the Seamless Transit Principles
Allocate $60,732,027 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds, with Conditions, for the Light-Rail Vehicle Procurement
Allocate $1,819,800 in Prop K Sales Tax Funds, with Conditions, for Two Projects
Amend the Adopted Fiscal Year 2019/20 Budget to Increase Revenues, Decrease Expenditures and Decrease Other Financing Sources for a Total Net Increase in Fund Balance of $7.0 Million
Approve San Francisco’s Draft Plan Bay Area 2050 Fiscally Constrained Project List
Award a Construction Contract, Ghilotti Construction Company, Inc., in an Amount not to Exceed $29,684,453, for the Southgate Road Realignment Improvement Project
Extend the Vision Zero Committee of the Transportation Authority Until December 31, 2020
